connections.name: BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit
connections.note: Use your own BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit API key. Tool calls may incur charges and send queries, URLs or other tool inputs to BaizhiCloud. Live Codewhale authentication and tools have not been qualified here.

connections.name: Linear
connections.note: Starts read-only. The service also supports a scoped API key in a bearer header. Codewhale account login is separate from Linear authorization.

connections.name: GitHub
connections.note: Use a fine-grained personal access token with only the repositories and permissions needed.

connections.name: Stripe
connections.note: Review scopes and use a test environment for initial qualification. Installation is not permission for a financial action.

connections.name: Supabase
connections.note: Scope to a project using project_ref before connecting. Start read-only.

connections.name: Resend
connections.note: The official remote setup uses OAuth. RESEND_API_KEY is not a verified login for this remote endpoint.

connections.name: Vercel
connections.note: Vercel requires an approved MCP client. Codewhale is not in the currently documented supported-client list; do not promise working login.

connections.name: Slack
connections.note: Requires an eligible Slack app and confidential OAuth client credentials. This is not an ordinary plug-and-play connection; use the Slack Events bridge for inbound bot work.

connections.name: Notion
connections.note: Authorize the workspace using the host's OAuth flow. Live Codewhale login has not been qualified here.

connections.name: Atlassian
connections.note: Jira and Confluence access follows the authorized account. Live Codewhale login has not been qualified here.

connections.note: Live Codewhale login has not been qualified here.
